title: incident-bot: adjust oncall diagnostics priority weighting and sampling
author: Asha Gupta
release_notes: tune: incident-bot oncall diagnostics priority weighting and sampling to reduce noise and improve runbook relevance
description: Motivation: oncall teams reported high noise from incident-bot diagnostics during paged incidents; many low-value suggestions were cluttering the channel and obscuring high-priority runbook links. This PR adjusts priority weighting and sampling heuristics so diagnostics surface higher-confidence suggestions first and rate-limit lower-priority observations. Summary of changes: 1) Introduces a configurable priority weighting config (incident_bot/config/priority_weights.yaml) that maps SLO severity, recent-retry count, and metric-anomaly-confidence to a single priority score; 2) Adds sampling layer that probabilistically suppresses verbose diagnostics below a configured priority threshold, with deterministic inclusion when a runbook link is available; 3) Implements sliding-window suppression for repeated identical diagnostics to avoid flood during sustained noise; 4) Exposes new per-team override flags in oncall-config to allow gradual rollout; 5) Adds comprehensive unit and integration tests and a small e2e harness that replays historical incidents to validate reduced message volume and preserved high-confidence suggestions. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve current behavior (sampling disabled) unless org-level override enabled. Rollout plan: feature gated by env var INCIDENT_BOT_PRIORITY_WEIGHTS=v1; staged rollout to staging for 48h, then alpha teams, then full rollout if telemetry shows >=30% reduction in low-priority messages and no decrease in runbook click-through rate. Related: ENG-3421 (reduce oncall noise), ENG-3490 (runbook prioritization), SUP-1289 (support case where runbook suggestions were missed). Checklist: - [x] design doc linked - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests - [x] e2e replay harness - [x] telemetry dashboards added - [x] documentation updated (docs/incident-bot/priority-weighting.md)
